description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Walgama (Central), Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820027
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, cadastral maps, land classifications, encumbrances, servitudes, and other property-related matters across multiple locations in Sri Lanka. The content is purely focused on land and property administration without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related matters.
